checks.message: Market of registered strategy 2TmcmquxnCB8AHoLmLJFYxZnVQdm9pREMEsmHqByQq7G with 2 mints; router config found.
The strategy reports the same mints, vaults and exact-out support the router recorded.
Every mint has its Pipeline fee account.
Resolves in at most 1 of 4 rounds in every direction; swaps need up to 2 strategy account(s).
The largest swap is 748 of 1232 bytes with 18 accounts, so it fits in a legacy transaction.
All 6 quotes succeeded through pipeline-quoter using only the resolved accounts (up to 7912 compute units each).
All 6 router swaps delivered exactly the quoted output and charged exactly the quoted input and fee.
In 2 direction(s), asking for one unit more than the quote makes the swap fail.
Repeated quotes agree, and two different traders get the anonymous quote.
Router swaps used 39806–45210 compute units, of which the strategy used up to 14921.
The market does not support exact-out.
In 2 pair(s), buying and immediately selling back returned less than was put in.
Zero-input quotes give no output, zero-input swaps are refused, and 1-unit swaps either fail cleanly or deliver what was quoted.
